title: Parasuram
desc: A police commissioner goes after a terrorist organisation to try and rescue misguided youngsters from the wrong path.

title: Navagraha Nayagi
desc: Goddess Maari Amman blesses those who sincerely pray to her and teaches a lesson to those who are involved in wrongdoings by performing miracles and healing.

title: Solaikuyil
desc: Maruthu arrives in Mulimalai, claiming kinship to a respected figure, but the village guard, Maayandi, is suspicious. Soon, a murder investigation raises questions about Maruthu's identity.

title: Vetri Malai
desc: Jeeva and Madhavi live with their dad and stepmother. Jeeva marries Raja, while Madhavi is visually impaired and has trouble getting married. Madhavi's life takes a turn when she meets Raja's friend.

title: Aranmanai Kavalan
desc: Sakthi takes upon himself to protect and fight for every Tamilian thriving in Mumbai. When he meets the wife of the late community-chief, he makes up his mind to resolve her family issues.
